component-o.description-s: 4-channel unidirectional ESD protection diodes with no VBUS / supply pin, 0.5 pF per line (DQA), 5.5 V standoff, 6.4 V min breakdown, 14 V clamp at 5 A TLP, IEC 61000-4-2 level 4 (+/-12 kV contact, +/-15 kV air), AEC-Q101, USON-10 2.5 x 1.0 mm flow-through

cfgpins-ao.6c: NC 6, 7, 9, 10: 'Not Connected; Used for optional straight-through routing. Can be left floating or grounded' (Pin Functions p3): the protected line may run through the NC pad opposite its channel.

cfgpins-ao.1c: Channels: D1+ (1) / D1- (2) on USB D+ / D-, D2+ (4) / D2- (5) on CC1 / CC2. Place as close to the connector as possible (Pin Functions note 1, p3). Any channel takes any line up to VIO 5.5 V (6.4 p4).

cfgpins-ao.7c: NC: no connect -- the datasheet labels it "NC" beside the pin (page 3); left open.

cfgpins-ao.9c: NC: no connect -- the datasheet labels it "NC" beside the pin (page 3); left open.

cfgpins-ao.10c: NC: no connect -- the datasheet labels it "NC" beside the pin (page 3); left open.

specs-o.cc_note-s: CC1/CC2 sit at <= 5.5 V in normal operation (VCONN included), inside VRWM 5.5 V. A cable fault that shorts CC to a 9 V (or 20 V) VBUS would conduct through this clamp (VBR 6.4-8.7 V); the TPS25730's own CC pins tolerate 26 V abs max. Not stated here: a CC-to-VBUS short rating.
specs-o.source-s: TI SLVSCO7C (Sept 2017): Pin Functions p3, 6.1-6.4 p4, 6.5 thermal p4, 6.6 Electrical Characteristics p5
